entities.summary: Edward Winslow Bryant Jr. was an American science fiction and horror writer sometimes associated with the Dangerous Visions series of anthologies that bolstered The New Wave. At the time of his death, he resided in North Denver. Edward Bryant was a authors & novelists from White Plains (1945-08-27, White Plains–2017-02-10). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
